title: Alternative classical Lagrangians for the Standard-Model Extension
summary: The current paper introduces classical, relativistic Lagrangians for point-particle analogs to the field theory description of the Standard-Model Extension (SME) for Lorentz violation. Lagrangians of a form alternative to those derived and studied in previous works are in the spotlight. Interestingly, they have well-defined massless limits, which makes them suitable for describing classical-particle analogs of photons subject to Lorentz violation.
